runtimeBoundary.note: This file freezes v0.4 design only. It must not be interpreted as deployed behavior.

researchBoundaries.channelAPlus: adaptive clarification/focus selection among repeated Channel-A candidates; analytically separate from raw MOST counts
researchBoundaries.channelBPlus: adaptive clarification among equally lowest eligible sufficiency items; analytically separate from Channel-B numeric ratings
forbiddenClaims: A+ selection creates a 3/3 MOST result
B+ selection is a diagnosis of the person's deepest or true need
LEAST means dislike or low importance
MOST minus LEAST is a psychological score
Channel A and Channel B are one-to-one constructs

flow: Channel A: 14 triads with MOST then LEAST when MOST is clear
A+ only when Channel A does not leave one direct focus under the rules below
B+ only when eligible Channel-B minima are tied under the rules below
result world: ship for Channel-A focus plus separate needs map for Channel-B/B+ route

channelAPlus.placement: after Channel A and before Channel B
channelAPlus.reasonForPlacement: Channel-B need wording must not prime the visual A+ runoff
channelAPlus.mostCountBasis: count only raw Channel-A MOST selections; no-clear trials add no MOST count

candidateRules.when: exactly one family has MOST count 3/3
two or more families have MOST count 3/3
no family has 3/3 and exactly one family has 2/3
candidateRules.action: skip A+ and use that family as the Channel-A focus

candidateRules.when: no family has 3/3 and two or more families have 2/3

candidateRules.action: do not manufacture a focus; skip A+

channelAPlus.participantPromptLt: Pažiūrėk į tas vaizdų grupes, kurios tavo pasirinkimuose kartojosi. Kuri grupė dabar pirmiausia patraukia dėmesį?

outcomes.noClear: no single Channel-A focus; preserve candidates for detail view but do not force a ship label

resultSemantics.heroShipLabel: Channel-A focus, not necessarily a raw 3/3

channelB.mapGrouping: six need continents containing the existing twelve Channel-B sufficiency items

channelBPlus.placement: after all Channel-B items and before final save/result

eligibility.ifNoNumericAnswers: skip B+ and produce no need route
eligibility.ifAllNumericValuesAre4Or5: skip B+ and produce no deficit-style route
eligibility.ifOneEligibleMinimum: skip B+; route may point to that one item directly
eligibility.ifTwoOrMoreExactEligibleMinima: run B+ among all exact-minimum items

channelBPlus.participantPromptLt: Šias sritis įvertinai vienodai žemai. Jei viena dabar vis dėlto atrodo mažiausiai pakankama, kuri?

outcomes.selectedOne: route endpoint is the selected need item
outcomes.similar: all tied-minimum need items remain route endpoints
outcomes.hardToSay: no single route endpoint is forced; tied candidates may be shown without a directional route

resultSemantics.routeMeans: where the participant's own sufficiency ratings, plus B+ when needed, place the lowest current sufficiency
resultSemantics.routeDoesNotMean: deepest need, true need, diagnosis, or Channel-A interpretation

needsMap.represents: Channel-B sufficiency and B+ clarification only

neutralChoiceBaseline.assumption: each of the three images is equally likely to receive MOST; no no-clear choices
neutralChoiceBaseline.warning: This is a combinatorial neutral baseline, not an empirical prediction of participant behavior. Real participants and no-clear responses can shift these rates.

nextImplementationRequirements: introduce a new v0.4 session schema; do not silently add A+/B+ semantics to rank-session-v0.3
introduce a new v0.4 draft namespace
keep bank-v0.3.1 if pixels do not change
persist A+ and B+ checkpoints separately
validate that A+ candidates are derivable from raw MOST counts
validate that B+ candidates are exact eligible minima derivable from Channel-B values
add owner-only synthetic edge-case harness before participant result-world implementation
do not replace live v0.2 or open external recruitment as part of this work
